title: feat(spec): userActions.transfer, the per-object switch for the Change Owner action, and its structural eligibility

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEpYDjddvdg2ymktFMmNiYa)_

Fixes #35401
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no file under skills/ teaches object-level userActions; the five userActions hits there are the view and interface-page block, a different key

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：本改动用户暂时无感；对象作者从此可以声明「这个对象是否提供改负责人操作」，Studio 对象表单的「用户操作」下多了一行「改负责人」。
- 为什么做：改负责人已定为平台标准操作，但明细、系统对象这类没有真正负责人的对象不该出现它，这是改负责人三步中的第一步（开关与资格判定）。
- 出错会怎样：资格判定或默认值读错，会让后续上线的改负责人按钮在不该出现的对象上出现或在该出现的对象上缺席；目前还没有任何界面读取它，作者写了开关会收到「尚未生效」提示，撤销本改动即可完全回滚。
- 要你做什么：无，席位落地。

### 席位核对

- **Read first (by risk):** `packages/spec/src/data/user-action-transfer.ts` (the structural test and the one resolution both follow-up cards will call); `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, the `refuseIneligibleUserActionTransfer` hunk (the new parse refusal, on every object parse); `packages/spec/liveness/object.json` (the `userActions` drill: `transfer` planned with authorWarn, `exportCsv` measured dead); `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts` (`transfer: crudFlag`).
- **Two-minute check:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/user-action-transfer.test.ts` — expect 1 file, 38 passed.
- **Size:** 29 files, +711 / -34 at `06e7a7d361`, under the 3,000 human-merge line. Two merges of `main`: `a49d553411` (clean) and `ef311d6fc6` after #35510 landed, with one hand resolution: the count pin in `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` set to 745 (main's 744 plus this PR's row), both comment paragraphs kept; then `06e7a7d361` regenerated api-surface, export-origins and two reference pages on the merged tree.
- **Landing order:** #35510 landed first; this PR merged `main` and set the shared positive-control count to 745. Clean against #35581.
- **Ruling:** maintainer ruling 7000907189 points 1 and 2 on #35315, carried as written; nothing re-decided.

## What changes

- **Structural eligibility (derived, never overridable).** `isTransferEligible(def)` and `transferIneligibilityReason(def)` in `@objectstack/spec/data`: true only when `resolveInjectedSystemColumns(def).owner` holds, the owner anchor is provable (an `external` object must declare or map its `owner_id`), and the object does not declare `owner_id` `readonly: true` (record- or array-shaped `fields`). So `ownership: 'business_unit' | 'org' | 'none'`, every `managedBy` object, every `sys_*` object, `systemFields: false` and an external object with no declared or mapped owner are never eligible. Each refusal reason carries its own arm's prescription where one exists.
- **The switch.** `userActions.transfer` takes the shape of the CRUD entries beside it (`boolean | { enabled, visibleWhen, disabledWhen }`, the same `RowCrudActionOverrideSchema` union). Omitted: on for `sharingModel` `private` / `public_read` / `public_read_write` and when `sharingModel` is omitted (a custom object then resolves to `private`); off for `controlled_by_parent`. Authors override both ways.
- **The one resolution.** `resolveUserActionTransfer(def)` returns `{ enabled, predicates? }`: eligibility first, then the switch, then the `sharingModel` default. The Change Owner endpoint (#35402) and the console action (#35403) will read it; nothing reads it yet.
- **Refused at parse (ADR-0049).** `transfer: true` or `{ enabled: true }` on an ineligible object is one located issue at `userActions.transfer`, naming the structural reason. Closing it (`false`) or a predicate-only form is accepted. `changeOwner` and `reassign` under `userActions` are refused with a pointer to `transfer`.
- **Gates the action, not the raw write** (ruling point 2): a plain `owner_id` update stays governed by `allowTransfer` alone.
- **Authoring surface:** the Studio object form gains a Change Owner row under User Actions, its label and help text in every shipped locale; regenerated `api-surface`, `export-origins` and reference docs.
- **Liveness (M1).** `object/userActions` is drilled and leaves the undrilled-containers baseline. `create` / `import` / `edit` / `delete` are `live`, each citing its reader. `transfer` is `planned` with `authorWarn` until #35402 / #35403 land, so `userActions.transfer: true` or its object form warns at `os lint` / `os validate`. `exportCsv` is graded dead per the drilled ledger, follow-up #35619: `resolveCrudAffordances` copies it onto `CrudAffordances.exportCsv` and nothing reads that bit (the export menus gate on export options and the export operation). The README forbids fanning the container's verdict out to the children; seat 5 ruled to keep the measured verdict.
- **Disclosed effect: a new author warning.** An object that sets `userActions.exportCsv: true` now gets a `liveness-dead-property` warning at `os lint` / `os validate`, with an authorHint saying export menus do not read it (`exportCsv: false` is not flagged; the changeset says the same). It is a warning, not a refusal; no stored object stops loading. #35619 enforces or removes the key.
- **FLS (S2).** `@objectstack/metadata-core` classifies `userActions.transfer` as `crudFlag`, with a pin, so the FLS mask treats it like its CRUD siblings.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/platform-objects` minor, `@objectstack/metadata-core` minor; declaration lines in its body.
